correctness.rationale: The published face criterion forces a three-face and its dual three-face to have strict vertex excess. Euler arithmetic gives six vertices in each; affine dimension gives four outside vertices; equality at ten vertices forces a tetrahedral free-join factor and hence only four containing facets, a contradiction. Duality gives the facet bound. The prism/dual-prism free join realizes eleven-by-eleven and violates the exact criterion by 12>11.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact natural size threshold in the first dimension where vertex-facet assignments can fail, supplies a canonical self-dual sharp witness, and improves a fourteen-by-fourteen construction to the provably minimal eleven-by-eleven size. This is a structural extremal fact rather than a routine parameter substitution.
